entities.summary: Johannes Beutler SJ was a German theologian and Catholic priest. Focused on the Gospel of John, he taught at Sankt Georgen Graduate School of Philosophy and Theology, the Pontifical Gregorian University, and the Pontifical Biblical Institute.
